projects.title: Aeon Crypt
projects.description: An interactive architectural projection Mapping & Spatial Synthesis exploring post-human ruins.
projects.objective: To map a 12th-century cathedral ruin with generative, volumetric light structures that visualize archaeological acoustics.
projects.approach: Utilizing deep procedural algorithms and generative design systems, we tracked and re-manifested acoustic reflections in real time.
projects.execution: We rigged three 30,000-lumen laser projectors with custom ultrasonic tracking arrays. The visual language was rendered in monochrome point-clouds.
projects.results: Over 45,000 visitors in 10 days. Documented as one of the most culturally significant site-specific digital art installations of the decade.

projects.title: Chronostasis
projects.description: A high-fashion sensory experience & cinematic campaign for the Paris Avant-Garde.
projects.objective: To disrupt the traditional digital fashion campaign model through hyper-slow physical kinetic movement and neural imagery.
projects.approach: We filmed model silhouettes using ultra-high-speed Phantom cameras at 1000fps under custom-programmed strobe frequencies.
projects.execution: Using physical textile simulations integrated with robotic lighting arrays, we synchronized physical motion with live soundscapes.
projects.results: Awarded Best Creative Direction at the Paris Fashion Film Festival. Campaign garnered over 18 million views organically and established a new benchmark for luxury visual marketing.

projects.title: Neural Monolith
projects.description: An experimental architectural sculpture translating global technological sentiment into live light fields.
projects.objective: Create an immersive, interactive landmark in central Tokyo that visualizes global technological discourse and climate streams.
projects.approach: We designed a monolithic 12-meter tall steel and LED obelisk that continuously scrapes environmental data feeds and computes complex fluid dynamics.
projects.execution: Leveraging heavy high-density outdoor microLED screens, precise thermal management systems, and a custom sentiment-analysis crawler.
projects.results: Acclaimed worldwide in Wired, AD, and design journals. Instantly became a cultural meeting point and experimental reference for urban sculpture.

projects.title: Vortex Synthesis
projects.description: A fluid dynamics sonic installation designed in collaboration with the London Acoustics Lab.
projects.objective: To visualize sound frequencies in physical, hyper-detailed water whirlpool structures.
projects.approach: We suspended heavy metallic resonance containers over custom sub-bass speakers, oscillating liquid columns with precise sound waves.
projects.execution: Integrated custom high-speed photography with strobe lighting arrays to lock liquid motions in visual states.
projects.results: Published as an independent research paper on wave-form visualization and exhibited globally.
